format: Studio / Custom: refund-driven withdrawal only for entries that have not danced
requirement: On a qualifying refund, cancellation or payment failure, an entry that has not danced is withdrawn and scratched automatically; an entry that has danced (or is held in a locked/certified heat or a heat on the floor) is never withdrawn automatically: participation and scoring evidence stay, an audited competition exception is raised for its round, and publication of that round is blocked pending authorized resolution. Financial-only exceptions (no entry scope) never block publication.
enforcement_point: Database functions and the registration trigger; exception scopes are append-only.

tests.name: A/Q1: an entry that has danced (unlocked heat) is NOT withdrawn
financial-only and resolved exceptions of the round do not block; another round's exception does not either
the participation class gates the automatic withdrawal; held entries raise an exception instead

interpretation_notes: RELEASE FINDING R12-F1 (low): the registration trigger path skips an entry that has ANY placement in a locked/certified heat even if that placement is scratched, while _r2_entry_participation_class ignores scratched placements in a locked heat (R2 P2-3a pins that the refund path withdraws such an entry). An entry with a scratched placement in a locked heat plus a scheduled placement in an open heat is therefore neither withdrawn nor given an exception when its registration is cancelled or its payment fails. Found by inspection; not reproduced by execution (PENDING). R12-F2 (info): an unattributed or reversed refund opens a competitive scope for every held (locked, not necessarily danced) entry of the order, which is conservative and can block that round until attributed or resolved by an owner/admin. R-12 says "has danced"; the implementation treats "held in a locked heat" the same (conservative; owner to confirm wording). DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy, never a governing-body requirement. Verified here by SQL inspection and static pins only; the SQL suites named were NOT executed by this session (PENDING an isolated Postgres under the heavy-lock queue). Independent review: R12-F5 (ballots do not mark an entry as danced) and R12-F6.
decision_refs: R-12 (owner ratification 2026-11-24: DanceFlow Studio/Custom policy; implementation verified only when the release candidate passes review and testing)
